summary:
The telemetry Host explicitly clears FsggCoherentSetVersion and packages the Dashboard assembly/assets with its own runtime closure. A coordination coherent-set publication therefore does not deliver later embedded Host/dashboard source. Verify the selected Host package manifest and source ancestry against the required consumer feature, rather than treating a newer CLI version as receiver compatibility.

Concrete source evidence: accepted Host0.7 publication binds2e60210be1e04d52fe0735a56333b3e3aef42284. Later PR4685 sourceaf9cc28605b70fc6c35e544f1666d0711143f829 changes Host composition to scopedDashboardSnapshotWithPassive and adds item-detail/4/private-dashboard/3 with unassignedUsage. The independent Host0.7 source predates that feature. Its generic passive receipt capability and synthetic package qualification do not establish that later browser presentation.

The owning Delivery4707 can prepare an independent Host successor without Home operations. Its full acceptance still needs an authentically published compatible artifact, exact installed receiver/store and credential custody, the4705 genuine canonical receipt, and an actual private projection/browser journey. Source tests and synthetic package/browser controls do not establish remote deployment or complete provider coverage. Historical package/publication/journal evidence remains immutable; current coordinate occupancy, source, authority and resource checks must be refreshed before any release effect.

The selected read-first source contract puts a mandatory closed feed/source/context gate directly after exact checkout in the existing Host candidate workflow, before SDK setup, tests, build, pack or candidate archive. Authenticated org and public indexes must demonstrate the known predecessor and normalized selected-version absence; exact package GETs must also report absence. Fixed GET identities, response/request limits, refusal of redirects/unreadability/contradictions, first-attempt/operator/ref binding and before/after protected-main checks prevent dependent work on uncertainty. Static workflow mutation tests and actual helper fake-transport controls are source qualification, not a live feed observation or candidate acceptance.

This changes only when the separately admitted candidate invocation may establish feed absence. Root still supplies actual tag/release occupancy, Authority journal destination/protection, exact accepted source and complete resource/custody admission before dispatch. The repository package-read token is not assumed to see private drafts or cross-repository Authority; checking a journal literal is source coherence, never native absence. Publisher preflight/publication and installed/Home acceptance remain distinct; a failed future gate preserves its original invocation rather than granting retry. The current source contract does not establish a live coordinate, deployed gate or selected candidate.
title: Embedded dashboard source needs the independent Host package release
